Senses.PreferredTarget: when the kalpa fire blazes, not a hair-tip remains
AlternateTargets: the kalpa fire blazes and consumes every hair-tip
SearchAliases: not a hair-tip survives the kalpa fire
Senses.Explanation: An image of the world-ending fire consuming everything down to the slightest hair-tip. Dafang Xinghai uses it in warning verse, Yuan'an Liao and Dounan Wei in independent funeral addresses, and Hansong Zhicao as a direct answer.
Senses.Note: The following green-mountains line supplies a deliberate counterpoint and should remain visible in context. Repeated copies of the inherited pair do not manufacture additional depth.
